title: Fully delimited template expressions: must be flagged
summary: Values that only begin a template or embed one between real-looking text, so they are not fully delimited template expressions. Covers 2 inputs.
rationale: A template expression is a reference to a secret, not the secret. Flagging it, or flagging only its inside, breaks templates that are correct.

expectation.rationale: Mutated documentation, placeholder, template, mask or reference. Expected masking follows a redact-secret issue decision, not a universal secret definition.
